statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes are I49.5, I48.91, R55
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The monitoring is intended to guide management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
